description: Filtered research subset of COUGHVID v3 by Lara Orlandic, Tomas Teijeiro and David Atienza (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7024894), licensed CC BY 4.0. Changes: retain 2466 recordings with consistent available binary expert labels and no poor/no_cough quality flag; package recording-level splits, original audio and multimodel calibrated training code. Labels are cough assessments, not confirmed clinical diagnoses. No demographic metadata included.
title: COUGHVID URTI Research Subset
